create_sensorfolder_dataset: create a SensorFolder dataset from a root directory with optional transform and baseline prefix
load_sensor_samples: load sensor image samples with their class index, sensor type, and serial number
exclude_sensors_by_type: exclude specific sensor types or serial numbers from the dataset using the exclude list
get_baseline_concatenated_sample: get a sample concatenated with its baseline image along the channel dimension
review_sensorfolder_class: review the SensorFolder class and its methods for sensor data loading and exclusion logic
